汐汐看着众人神色凝重，加上胡九郎说的话，也不敢多做停留，连忙和众人道别，匆匆上车离去，临走前还不忘再次叮嘱胡九郎，若有什么问题，她还会联系胡九郎的。

胡九郎此刻心思都在杨童身上。

“嗯，好！”

汐汐看到他心不在焉。

“如果有什么需要我的，也可以开口！”

胡九郎点了点头，汐汐开车离去，其他人也迅速上车，车厢内的气氛比之前更加压抑，李二牛眉头紧锁，双手紧紧攥着那串铜钱，神色严肃得吓人，一言不发，只有指尖偶尔转动的铜钱，发出细微的清脆声响，透着几分焦躁。

胡九郎看着李二牛紧绷的神色，又看了看身边依旧心有余悸、脸色苍白的杨童，轻声开口道：

“李大哥，你也别太着急，白仙既然没有当场动手，就说明还有转圜的余地，你肯定有办法护住小杨的。”

李二牛缓缓抬起头，眼神凝重地看了杨童一眼，沉声道：

“不是我着急，白仙孤僻多疑，记仇得很，这次虽然暂时退去，可杨家的旧怨摆在那里，它绝不会就这么轻易放过丫头。回到镇子后所有人都听我的，把异能者失踪、邪教这些事全部放下，先护住丫头的性命再说！”

众人纷纷点头，对此自然没有任何意见。

范梦雪看着杨童，小声安慰道：

“杨姐，你别害怕，有李大哥和师兄在，一定会没事的。”

车子很快抵达青峰镇，李二牛没有让众人回之前的客栈，而是带着大家，绕到镇子西侧的一处僻静小院，这是他之前在青峰镇落脚时，临时租下的院子，清净隐蔽，也方便布置防御，避开五仙的耳目。

走进小院，李二牛立刻吩咐道：

“阡陌那小子，你去院子四周，把我给你的黄符，按照东南西北四个方位贴好，记住，符脚一定要朝向院子中央，不能贴反；林姑娘，你守在院门口，那两个小丫头，你们两个在院子里巡逻，不要让任何人靠近正房，也不要随便触碰院子里的布置。”

众人立刻行动起来，各司其职，快速按照李二牛的吩咐布置妥当。黄符贴上墙面的瞬间，泛起淡淡的金光，形成一道无形的屏障，将整个小院笼罩其中，驱散着周围的阴邪之气，也隔绝着外界五仙的窥探。

李二牛则带着杨童和胡九郎，走进正房，随后关上房门，神色严肃地对杨童道：

Xixi looked at everyone's solemn expressions, and because of what Hu Jiulang said, she didn't dare to stay any longer. She quickly said goodbye to everyone, got in the car and left in a hurry. Before leaving, she didn't forget to remind Hu Jiulang again that if there were any questions, she would contact him.

Hu Jiulang's thoughts were all on Yang Tong at the moment.

"Well, good!"

Xixi saw that he was absent-minded.

"If you need anything from me, just ask!"

Hu Jiulang nodded, Xi Xi drove away, and the others quickly got into the car. The atmosphere in the car was even more depressed than before. Li Erniu frowned, holding the string of copper coins tightly in his hands, with a frighteningly serious look on his face, without saying a word. Only the coins occasionally turned by his fingertips made a slight crisp sound, showing a bit of anxiety.

Hu Jiulang looked at Li Erniu's tense expression, then looked at Yang Tong, who was still frightened and pale beside him, and said softly:

"Brother Li, don't be too anxious. Since Bai Xian didn't take action on the spot, it means there is still room for change. You must have a way to protect Xiao Yang."

Li Erniu slowly raised his head, glanced at Yang Tong solemnly, and said in a deep voice:

"It's not that I'm anxious. Bai Xian is withdrawn, suspicious, and very vindictive. Although it has temporarily receded this time, the Yang family's old grudges are still there, and they will never let the girl go so easily. After returning to the town, everyone will listen to me and put aside all the things like the disappearance of the superpower and the cult, and protect the girl's life first!"

Everyone nodded and naturally had no objections to this.

Fan Mengxue looked at Yang Tong and comforted her in a low voice:

"Sister Yang, don't be afraid. With Brother Li and Senior Brother here, everything will be fine."

The car soon arrived at Qingfeng Town. Instead of letting everyone go back to the inn, Li Erniu took everyone around to a secluded courtyard on the west side of the town. This was the courtyard he temporarily rented when he settled in Qingfeng Town. It was clean and hidden, and it was also convenient for setting up defenses to avoid the eyes and ears of the Five Immortals.

Entering the small courtyard, Li Erniu immediately ordered:

"That boy from Qianmo, go around the courtyard and stick the yellow talisman I gave you in the four directions of southeast, northwest and northwest. Remember, the feet of the talisman must face the center of the courtyard and cannot be pasted backwards. Miss Lin, guard at the entrance of the courtyard. Those two little girls, you two patrol the courtyard. Don't let anyone get close to the main house, and don't touch the decorations in the courtyard."

Everyone immediately took action, each performing their duties, and quickly arranged everything according to Li Erniu's instructions.The moment the yellow talisman was attached to the wall, a faint golden light glowed, forming an invisible barrier that enveloped the entire courtyard, dispersing the evil spirit around it and blocking the prying eyes of the five immortals from the outside world.

Li Erniu took Yang Tong and Hu Jiulang into the main room, then closed the door and said to Yang Tong seriously:
